caption: The drawing features three main objects: a seal stamp, a group of ribbon pieces, and a wax seal impression. At the top, there is a wooden-handled seal stamp, with the handle colored in varying shades of brown and the metal stamp portion rendered in bluish-gray. Several ribbon pieces in yellow and pale blue are tied around the handle. Below the stamp, there is a reddish-brown wax seal impression, round in shape, with a somewhat irregular, scalloped outer edge. The seal features an image of a bird with wings raised and the text “BERGEN ACADEMY SEAL” encircling the bird. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a small circular sketch of the same seal impression labeled "ACTUAL SIZE" with dimensions "1 1/8 IN." marked beside it. The background is plain off-white.
title: Bergen Academy Seal
